summary: Per-unit evidence closure is repaired: duplicate packet evidence IDs are rejected, and independent full-chain two-unit mutations showed discrepancy, primary-source reveal, verification, and resolution evidence cannot cross unit boundaries. The source-only prompt repair remains incomplete. Its hand-maintained deny tuple omits manifest-frozen semantic implementation paths and multiple post-reveal conclusion fields, so canonical completeness and blind prompt builders, including the write CLI, emit those values.

findings.title: Source-only prompt preflight remains a partial denylist
findings.contract: Before either canonical completeness or blind prompt is written, source-only payload preflight must reject every downstream rule/semantic/implementation path and every closed post-reveal field identifier. The protection must cover the locked downstream artifact set and schemas rather than a selected examples list.

evidence.detail: Lane A and Lane B are source-only, implementation files are excluded, and blind prompts may not contain downstream rule paths, semantic paths, or conclusion fields.

SOURCE_ONLY_FORBIDDEN_TOKENS is a manually enumerated subset. It lists js/, three semantic document roots, and selected downstream fields, but omits manifest-frozen scripts/build_semantic_pilots.py and post-reveal fields including rootCauseId, authorityOverride, classification, hiddenDefault, verificationEvidenceRefs, and reviewedDiscrepancyIds.

The preflight recursively compares string values only against that partial tuple; it neither derives forbidden paths from the manifest nor derives post-reveal identifiers from the comparison/adjudication schemas.
Both prompt modes call the partial preflight, then main() computes canonical bytes and writes them. There is no later complete source-only content check before output.write_bytes().
The closed post-reveal discrepancy contract defines omitted identifiers including classification, rootCauseId, authorityOverride, hiddenDefault, and sourceFinding.
The closed adjudication contract defines omitted identifiers including resolution, verificationEvidenceRefs, reviewedDiscrepancyIds, sourceChecked, and finding.

The committed preflight control tests only docs/rules/semantics/pilots.json and the combined listed values js/engine.js downstreamPath; it does not inventory the frozen semantic map or post-reveal schema identifiers.

observed: Positive controls were rejected before output for docs/rules/semantics/pilots.json, js/engine.js, and downstreamPath.

A schema-valid packet searchTerms value of scripts/build_semantic_pilots.py passed completeness preflight; canonical bytes contained it, and an isolated invocation of main() returned 0 and wrote an output containing it.
Schema-valid source-only string values rootCauseId, authorityOverride, and verificationEvidenceRefs each passed completeness preflight and remained in canonical bytes.

An accepted completeness-review claim containing scripts/validate_semantic_pilots.py rootCauseId passed blind preflight; canonical blind bytes contained both values, and an isolated invocation of main() returned 0 and wrote rootCauseId.

findings.impact: A packet author or completeness reviewer can seed source-only reviewers with frozen semantic-builder/validator paths and downstream comparison/adjudication vocabulary while preserving canonical prompt bytes. Because these omitted values are also absent from the validator's shared forbidden tuple, the current source-only blindness boundary remains bypassable.
minimalFix: Derive the forbidden exact-path set from every locked non-source downstream artifact exposed after reveal, including frozenSemanticHashes, frozenConciseRuleHashes, manifest target paths, and implementation roots; do not rely on a manually selected prefix tuple.
Derive the forbidden post-reveal identifier set from the closed comparison and adjudication schemas, subtracting only explicitly justified source-only shared identifiers.
Apply the same complete preflight to packet and accepted completeness-review payloads inside canonical_prompt_bytes() before any output path is created or written.
Add inventory-driven controls that iterate every forbidden path/identifier through both prompt modes and assert the CLI leaves no output file.

verifiedControls.detail: The exact listed semantic path, implementation path, and downstreamPath examples fail preflight. The finding concerns omitted members of the same closed classes.

A packet with two distinct rows sharing E1 was rejected with exactly one duplicate packet evidence ID failure. Canonical completeness bytes can still be rebuilt before this validator rejection, but no validated lane chain accepts the duplicate.
Packet evidence IDs and exact path/SHA tuples are indexed by auditUnitId; conflicting per-unit hashes are rejected.
A valid two-unit baseline passed; changing RULE:FND-001's discrepancy reference from E1 to E2 assigned only to RULE:FND-002 produced exactly one outside-source-packet failure.
Revealing the FAQ path/SHA assigned only to RULE:FND-002 as RULE:FND-001 primary-source evidence produced exactly one absent-from-packet failure.
Independent two-unit mutations using E2 only in RULE:FND-001 verification and source-blocked resolution each produced exactly one scoped-evidence failure.

testsRun.result: REPRODUCED: incomplete completeness/blind preflight and actual isolated CLI writes; VERIFIED: duplicate-ID rejection and four independent current-unit evidence/source closure controls

issuesEncountered: The user bounded the review after the focused probes completed, so no additional broad mutation/decision suite rerun was launched. The finding and all requested evidence-closure checks are backed by completed focused execution.
residualRisks: The canonical prompt builder can serialize a duplicate evidenceId packet before validate_packet rejects it. The reviewed validated chain is fail-closed, but moving uniqueness into the shared pre-write packet preflight would better enforce the candidate-2 stated ordering.
The focused review did not exhaustively enumerate every omitted downstream identifier; the reproduced members prove the current manually maintained tuple is not closed.
This is a prelock harness review. All 140 units remain pending; no claim is made about future substantive audit conclusions.
